description_text:
Capturing Innocence in 3D: Human Kid/Child 3D Print Model in STL FormatIntroductionCreating lifelike human models in 3D has long been a cornerstone of digital art, medical simulation, toy design, and animation. Among these, 3D models of children or human kids stand out due to their expressive features, unique proportions, and emotional depth. Whether used for figurines, educational tools, medical training, or digital sculpting, a child 3D model in STL format offers a versatile and valuable asset for creators and professionals across industries.
Why 3D Models of Children Are UniqueChildren's bodies differ greatly from adults in terms of proportion, anatomy, and surface detail. Capturing a child's form in 3D requires careful attention to:
Soft facial features and rounded forms
Larger eyes and head-to-body ratio
Natural, expressive poses
Age-accurate anatomical proportions
A well-crafted child model balances realism with charm, whether it’s stylized or photorealistic.
Features of a High-Quality Kid/Child STL 3D ModelDetailed AnatomyDepending on the purpose, the model may include highly accurate anatomical features or be stylized for toys or animation.
Clean TopologyWhile STL files are mesh-only (non-editable topology), high-quality models are still optimized to print cleanly—no holes, inverted normals, or non-manifold edges.

Cultural or Religious Figurines: Used in nativity scenes, dioramas, or historical displays

Best Practices for 3D Printing Kid ModelsMaterial Choice:
PLA or ABS: Ideal for general figurine printing
Resin (SLA/DLP): Best for high-resolution prints with fine detail (e.g., fingers, facial features)

Teresa of vila
Saint Teresa of vila, also called Saint Teresa of Jesus, baptized as Teresa Snchez de Cepeda y Ahumada (28 March 1515 4 October 1582), was a prominent Spanish mystic, Roman Catholic saint, Carmelite nun and author during the Counter Reformation, and theologian of contemplative life through mental prayer. She was a reformer in the Carmelite Order of her time and the movement she initiated, later joined by Saint John of the Cross, eventually led to the establishment of the Discalced Carmelites, though neither she nor Saint John were alive when the two orders separated.
In 1622, forty years after her death, she was canonized by Pope Gregory XV, and on 27 September 1970 was named a Doctor of the Church by Pope Paul VI.[5] Her books, which include her autobiography (The Life of Teresa of Jesus) and her seminal work El Castillo Interior (trans.: The Interior Castle), are an integral part of Spanish Renaissance literature as well as Christian mysticism and Christian meditation practices. She also wrote Camino de Perfeccin (trans.: The Way of Perfection).
After her death, Saint Teresa's cult was known in Spain during the 1620s, and for a time she was considered a candidate to become a national patron saint. A Santero image of the Immaculate Conception of El Viejo, said to have been sent with one of her brothers to Nicaragua by the saint, is now venerated as the country's national patroness at the Shrine of El Viejo.[6] Pious Catholic beliefs also associate Saint Teresa with the esteemed religious image called Infant Jesus of Prague with claims of former ownership and devotion.

Guybrush Threepwood
Character Description
The 3D model was created on Monkey Island inspired base. Model formats: - *.Blend (Blender)- *.3Ds- *.fbx- *.mtl- *.obj- *.dxf* All texture is included in the set. * renders Are made in Blender 2.73a If you need any other formats I am more than happy to make them for you. The model is provided combined, all main parts are presented as separate parts therefore materials of objects are easy to be modified or removed and standard parts are easy to be replaced. If you experience difficulties with separating standard parts I am more than happy to give you qualified assistance. I greatly appreciate you choosing my 3D models and hope they will be of use. I look forward to continuously dealing with you. Enjoy it!
Sincerely Yours, 
Luca

description_text:
This is a instructional model of what happens when you lift a heavy object with the wrong technique. The hole diameters are 3mm, and it is recommended to insert washers between joints for smoother movement. 
You will also need to run 2 lengths of elastic from the shoulders down to the pelvis, one for the front set of holes, and one for the back set. The back elastic must be stronger than the front, and the model should have its back erect when not lifting. 
You can tie a knot at the shoulder section to stop the elastic slipping down the hole. At the pelvic side, the elastic can be tied to a short length of toothpick or dowel and fitted into the slot provided.
The bucket can be printed with zero or near zero infill, and whilst printing, feel free to drop in some sand or ball bearings to provide the required weight.
Lastly, there are two versions here. One is with the legs at an angle, this is more of an aesthetic thing, and it more closely resembles our own anatomic orientation when bending down and lifting something between our legs. The other is with the legs in a parallel orientation (denoted with the word _straight in the file name). 
I have included both as it can sometimes be tricky to have the joint holes line up, especially if you plan to drill out the holes for smoother movement.

description_text:
My take on little Alice in Wonderland, posable version.
Checkout the different designs in my collection from simple cute designs to scary organic sculpts. 
Most of my work is sculpted directly in Oculus Medium VR.Most objects are separate elements which means you can mix and match to achieve the effect you want.
Take note to double check and resize accordingly before 3D printing.I have included many files of different level of details for your convenience. Refer to filename for Poly Count (K=thousands of Triangle polygons).
These are Oculus Home ready models, just copy the .GLB files, which are just binary versions of the new glTR file format into your “oculus home ->  _import” folder. 
The photos and videos are created directly in the Medium VR 3D engine.I definitely had fun creating this project from within VR. 
If you enjoy what you see then give a like or comment to support more of this effort.

BABY YODA FROM THE SERIES THE MANDALORIAN
Baby Yoda with Cup/Mug Cut in 3 parts: Head, Body, Cup.Ready for 3D printing.

The Child, colloquially referred to as Baby Yoda by fans and the media, is a fictional character from the Star Wars Disney+ original television series The Mandalorian. He is of the same alien species as Jedi Master Yoda, a popular character from the original trilogy and prequel trilogy of Star Wars films. The Child was well received by audiences and quickly became an Internet meme and breakout character.

Yoda is a fictional character in the Star Wars franchise created by George Lucas, first appearing in the 1980 film The Empire Strikes Back. In the original trilogy, he trains Luke Skywalker to fight against the Galactic Empire. In the prequel trilogy, he is amongst the most powerful members of the Jedi Order and a general of clone troopers during the Clone Wars. Before his death in Return of the Jedi at the age of 900, Yoda was the oldest living character in the Star Wars franchise in canon, until the introduction of Maz Kanata in The Force Awakens.

description_text:
Well , it seems that I am back to work , and that is after a long time not working , actually I vanished from here for while for some reasons , the first and most important one is that I was taking some test , and if any one cared about the result , I faild although I successed , but I can simply recognize that the one who tests you wish that you fail or not from the rules .
Faild , Successed , live , dead all are nothing , I found that at this time no one liked my products , and I know the reason , now I can see that every one wait for me to be good kind boy and say that it is my fault , but I will not say that , the reason is simply that we are at very advantage time , when the 3d and design is so common , the first time in my life I saw 3d work I was in primary school then , and I saw a video clip for a game named Odd world , surly this was magic , and every one thought that the aliens are some kind of suit that makes actor looks like that , but no one knew it is 3d , although there was cool PC games that ate my minds then like Tarzan .
As you see that the so simple 3d work was like a heavenly works , although tarzan looked like a piece of carved wood then in the game , but at this time your mind would recognize that it is so real , and this is the natural thing , the peoples in the real life do not look like this becuase they are not good nor pretty enough like Tarzan from the game , at the first year of the preparatory school , I do not know if you have the same studying system in your countries or not , but it is primary school , and preparatory school , prepare you to go to the secondary school , then you study to go to the collage .
At this first year , there was a TV show named Graphic , every Friday , then I saw that there is a software named studio max , and a short movie of a warrior entered a temple of monsters figures , and then some monster came to life and awakened the other figures and sarrounded the warrior who dropped his sword , then they all started to dance to gether with the warrior ...... So lame , so poor in geometry that they all loked a poor wooden sculpting , and the shading was suck .
But I saw it with a sparking eyes , and lived years dreaming to have such a software , although I was not having a computer , year 2002 was the second year of the preparatory school , and we got a PC , but later I knew it is junk , becuase it almost could run spider man , I always was dreaming of creating my own characters in 3d , then my uncle at year 2008 gave me my first 3d soft ware , that my junk PC can run it , and it was Poser 3 , of course it was so hard to make movie with the clothes which was fashion at the time of lunching this soft ware .
The clothe were just shirt and pants and classic shoes , so cool in the time of jeans , and modern fashion and characters design at 2008 , there was final fantasy which says that this fashion is no longer needed , but I can't get better soft ware becuase of my PC , later I spared money and brought a better PC , and later I got Iclone 4 , which was so good at this time .
And I evolved my work until I reached to the level you see , but at this time the 3d became so common , and so many people worked at it like here in this site , so what I am trying to do here is to sell water in the street of the water sellers , as it said in my home land , whatever the products is good , even the one who does not know any thing about 3d design will not care that much , because he saw many 3d works , like Avatar , Transformers , Lord of the rings , and they are not all like Tarzan of ps 1 .
The first time I saw , Harry potter , Narnia , I felt they are great movies , next parts of them I was bored , becuase the fantasy of them is so pretty , but so common , so we are used of it , but we still try to find our way .

description_text:
Killua has spiky silver hair, very pale skin, and blue eyes. His eyes change shape depending on the mood that he's in, narrowing and sharpening when he goes into assassination mode. Killua is fairly lean at the start of the series, due to constant physical conditioning and torture training he received when he was young. As time passes, he becomes more muscular and toned. In the Nippon Animation anime adaptation, Killua's eye color is changed to green during the OVAs. He is also often seen holding a green skateboard (turned yellow in the 2011 series).
Killua typically wears baggy clothing, with his usual attire consisting of long-sleeved and dark-colored shirts. Most of his clothes have a turtleneck. Killua wears long, baggy shorts in the manga and Madhouse animated adaptation, but Nippon Animation's character design shortened them to reach above his knees. Killua also wears purple boots, recolored brown and black in the Nippon Animation adaptation.
As a child, Killua's hair is longer, almost cascading to his shoulders. He wore a hoodie with his trademark blue coloring, grey pants, and shoes.

description_text:
High poly mesh of a bust statue representing a young woman.
There is a png file containing the terracotta texture.
The statue is signed by the artist Jean-Baptiste Pigalle.
wiki page of J.B. Pigalle : Pigalle was born in Paris, the seventh child of a carpenter. Although he failed to obtain the Prix de Rome, after a severe struggle he entered the Académie Royale and became one of the most popular sculptors of his day. His earlier work, such as Child with Cage (model at Sèvres) and Mercury Fastening his Sandals (Berlin, and lead cast in Louvre), is less commonplace than that of his more mature years, but his statue of Voltaire, dated 1776 (initially in the Institut de France, purchased by the Louvre in 1962), and his tombs of Comte d'Harcourt (c. 1764) (Notre Dame de Paris) and of Marshal Saxe, completed in 1777 (Saint-Thomas Lutheran church, Strasbourg), are good examples of French sculpture in the 18th century.
Pigalle taught the sculptor Louis-Philippe Mouchy, who married his niece, and who closely copied Pigalle's style.[2][3] He is also said to have taught the painter Madeleine-Élisabeth Pigalle, believed to be a distant relative from Sens.[4] His name is most commonly known today because of the Pigalle red-light district in Paris, located around the square of the same name.
Pigalle died in Paris on 20 August 1785.

description_text:
STL Size:                  Z: 250 (mm)                 Y: 115 (mm)                 X: 167 (mm)
Kratos is a title character and the protagonist of Santa Monica Studio's God of War series, which was based on Greek mythology, before shifting to Norse mythology. Kratos, also known as the Ghost of Sparta, first appeared in the 2005 video game God of War, which led to the development of seven additional games featuring the character as the protagonist. Kratos also appears as the protagonist of the 2010 and 2018 comic series, as well as the franchise's three novels that retell the events of three of the games. The character was voiced by Terrence C. Carson from 2005 to 2013, with Christopher Judge taking over the role in 2018's continuation, also titled God of War. Antony Del Rio voiced the character as a child in God of War: Ghost of Sparta.
Throughout the Greek era of the series, Kratos embarks on several adventures in attempts to avert disaster or to change his fate, though primarily to seek revenge on the Greek Gods, towards whom he harbors intense hate, due to their roles in his suffering. He is usually portrayed as being oblivious to all else and is stoic, bloodthirsty and arrogant in nature. He often engages in morally ambiguous activities and performs acts of extreme violence. Once a respected Spartan warrior, he became the Ghost of Sparta after accidentally killing his family due to Ares' trickery. He later avenges the deaths of his family and becomes the God of War after killing Ares. Kratos is eventually revealed to be a demigod and the son of Zeus, who later betrays him. Vengeance is a central theme of the Greek era, and each installment provides additional information about Kratos' origins and his relationships with his family and the Olympian gods. In the Norse era of the series, Kratos takes a turn for the good and finds himself controlling his rage and learning how to truly be a father and mentor to his new son, Atreus. Along their journey, they combat monsters and gods of the Norse realm, of whom they make enemies.
The God of War franchise is a flagship title for the PlayStation brand and Kratos is one of its most popular characters. The character has been well received by critics and has become a video game icon, a relative newcomer among more established franchise characters, such as Mario, Link, Sonic the Hedgehog and Master Chief. The character is now associated with other products and has had various cameos in PlayStation games outside of the God of War series

Hi all,
this is Stone demon, game ready, low poly.The model has 4096x4096 PBR textures with metallic workflow (albedo, metallic, normal, ao, emission).Demon is rigged with a humanoid skeleton, so it works great in the game engine and you can retarget any animation to this model. If you have any other questions or need adjustments, feel free to contact me.
Peter

modeling of a totem of Cthulhu under Zbrush, format stl and obj, size of 20 cm of the object to respect for a good definition, you can print it in PLA or ABS with a definition of 0.1mm
Cthulhu is a monstrous cosmic entity invented by the American writer Howard Phillips Lovecraft in his short story The Call of Cthulhu, published in the pulp Weird Tales in 1928 .
Gigantic extraterrestrial creature asleep for millennia in the city of R'lyeh engulfed under the waves of the Pacific Ocean, Cthulhu is worshiped like a god by stray humans and aquatic beings who worship him immemorial through antediluvian sculptures . These reproduce its vaguely humanoid shape completed by a cuttlefish head, octopus tentacles and wings similar to those of a dragon1.
The writer August Derleth designates under the term myth of Cthulhu the set of literary pastiches which are inspired by the fictional universe of Lovecraft. The term remained, helping to multiply references to the creature in popular culture through literature, role-playing games and video games.

description_text: This Warrior Helmet Package 01 is based on the fantasy helmets of Greek and Norse design. This cap is renowned for its iconic look. It’s ideal for barbarians, D&D villains, even sword and sorcery characters. Our helmet is fully customizable to allow for multiple color options. It was designed for a standard height figure (186 cm) in Cinema 4D and Zbrush. This package is ideal for game assets, illustration, and animation. It’s sized for standard figures in Unity, Poser or Daz Studio. I’ve broken the model down into its basic components for ease of customization. This Warrior Helmet Package 01 can be used in a variety of programs. I’ve included the file formats:• 3DS• DFX• OBJ (medium, high)• FBX • MAX• STL• ZTL • C4D• 3D COATThe package offers textures and two obj files. The mesh comes in high and medium polygon options to fit your needs. The 3DS Max version and the Cinema 4D version allow for mesh smoothing. Textures are included in 2048x2048 for clear resolution. The package includes the following maps:• Diffuse• Normal• Fresnel• Reflectance• RoughnessThe package is presented in zip format. This requires an unzipping tool which most computers have as standard application. Use the appropriate format into your favorite 3D modeling program and customize the textures. The Warrior Helmet Package 01 models come pre-UV mapped along with a handy bitmap template from which to layout your own textures. Feel free to drop your suggestions to me for both realistic and fantasy style headgear.Be sure to check out the other models in my gallery. I’m always adding more models, so check back regularly; just click on my user name.

description_text: This is part of a Medieval Fantasy Figurine Set I wanted to make with the main fantasy classes found in MMOs, RPGs, and Tabletop Dungon games. This is a Elvin Berserker for the Mistress Army. She carries a GIANT SWORD and is ready to crush her opponents guard with punishing attacks. Without any shield and Mid Light armor, she is vunerable to heavy attacks but her solutionis swift lighting fast evasion. As a evasive damage dealer, she can slash a tank into ribbons, quickly, and feircly.I found that Scale 339.06% for 130mm is fun and prints fine as a Full Print. I also found that Scale 898.50% is great for a large 10 Inch collectable keyed statue that is a BLAST to paint. I used clear blue resin for the smaller base crystal rocks and I hot glued her (detatches with isopropic) to a crystal RGB display I found on Amazon. She comes with an Alternate Claymore Sword to smash and pierce the Helms of her foes. Have fun painting her and putting her in a cool display, or play her as your dnd character! Please support my 3D printing and statue designs if you like my style! Thank you!  Avail File Types : FBX, OBJ, ZTL, CHITUBOX, and STL.

|| GENERAL ||
Model is built to real-world scale(the unit system is metric). No third-party renderer or plug-ins needed.
|| ADDITIONAL NOTES ||

description_text: Hello every one .   A figure of a book for 3D printing can be so pretty for a liberary or universty , who knows !?A figure of arabian man head can be used for many purposes  .When I designed this model  I was attending a graphic and 3D course in my home land and there was a graduation project , so my team decided to build a 3D liberary in 3D max , the liberary was place in my home land that closed since a very long time , so they said why imagine some thing that dosen't existing while we have some thing just need to be alive again .The building named The Italian house because in the seconed global war Italy was supposed to win the war and some of the Italian important person moved to port said my home city and lived in this house , but after the war end they leaved and abandoned the house and the people of port said called it The Italian house , but it remained so long without a person to step inside it even the people forgot about it and don't know what this building was .It contained a liberary and theater so when they thought about it they called it liberary and my team asked me to create a figures for it , and this book stand was one of my figures that they used and putted it in the garden of the building , but it also has some other uses that you would like , but first you need to print it in 3D model because it's foemate is STL .

  - For custom image/text, use the template located in textures_chest_message.zip and follow the instruction in the template.

  - For blender users, convert the normal map from DirectX to OpenGL using the node group provided in the blend file, as shown in the last image above.

description_text:
A courageous and Fearless Octopus who is not afraid to take part in an actually dangerous and deadly risky performance.
In this classic moving target stunt, which is known as the Wheel of Death, the octopus is secured to a massive target board that is free to spin about its center point. 
While our hero is rotating, scary and sharp arrows are thrown at it rapidly and consistently.
The mission is to stay unharmed and dodge all the arrows leaving its body intact and safe.
It has been an agile rock star of this fascinating incredible circus show all its life and performed to the surprise of the audience showing its uniqueness and unrivaled!
~ ~ ~
This model is created in 3ds Max 2018, and textured in Substance Painter.
The model is suitable for any visual production - broadcast, high-res film, advertising, games, design visualization, etc.
The model file contains:
  - Model, materials with customized textures; light sources and camera (studio-setup).
File formats:

  - .max

  - .obj

  - .fbx

The model consists of 5 separate objects with unique names.
The model uses 5 materials.
All visible textures are included. 
Some types of textures:

  - for V-Ray: Diffuse, Glossiness, Normal, Height, Reflection, IOR, Opacity, Emission.

  - for real-time projects: Basecolor, Height, Metallic, Normal, Roughness, Emission.

  - for Unity and Unreal Engine.

Textures Resolutions (in PNG format) - 2048 x 2048
Polygons - 56 687Tris - 111 200Vertices - 56848
The preview images are rendered with the V-Ray 3.60.03 renderer and Marmoset Tool 3.
If you render this file using a different version of this renderer, you may not have the same results as you see on the thumbnails.
~ ~ ~
Please contact me if you have any issues with the model.
Thank you for your purchase, I hope this model will be useful for your project!
And don't forget to rate the model, I really appreciate it!
Best regards,Ilona

description_text:
Magna Nemeriss is a complete kit to build a large high rank priestess.The model is 90mm tall and can fit on a 60mm base
The kit offers several different options and can fit both Iron Hive or Dark Techno ranks ;

  - Character has 2 normal arms

  - The staff can have or not the alien specimen

  - optional tail

  - 2 different heads with/witout headdress

  - Iconography on clothes and equipment can be removed (non merged parts)

The 4 mechanical arms slots can be equipped by :

  - incense burner

  - relic lantern

  - command speaker

  - neurobeacon

  - mechanical swords

  - mechanical scythes

  - teslatic obliterator

  - powerclaw

Recommended tube for the staff with specimen :https://www.jacksonsart.com/jackson-s-transparent-plastic-brush-head-protector-6-3x250mm-pack-of-10
Every part is included with both supported and non-supported versions for ease of printing.Every file is tested for resin printing. Test prints were done on Anycubic Photon/Elegoo Mars, with 0.05mm layer height, and 12 seconds exposure.

  - Private Use Only

===> GENERAL:This 3d model is a helmet for a character like robots or warriors. It is modelled as a poly mesh for subdivision for example with Turbosmooth in 3ds Max and as a low poly mesh for games.
===> GEOMETRY:The object is modelled in 3ds Max with and consists largely of quads. The helmet is one mash with three faceID groups for the different materials.The download includes also the LowPoly glTF version.
===> RIGGING:This object contains no rigs.
===> UVs:The whole geometry is flat unwrapped in one atlas with no overlapping UVs.
===> MATERIALS / TEXTURES:For this mesh I used just procedural materials and maps like VrayCarpaint2 and VrayDirtMap. So for this object no textures are provided.
---> RENDERINGS:For the renderings here, I used Vray 5 update 1.2.

description_text:
This is a package containing three figures:

  - Agnia (agnia.obj, agniastand.obj). She is a dancer. Bright, in an flying emotional state, all in motion, just like fire. I named it Agnia.   Agniya - fiery, bright, pure (from the word Agni rus. fire, Sk. अग्नि - «fire»). 

  - Ballerina (ballerina.obj, ballerinastand.obj)This sculpture shows the moment of classical ballet. A ballet gesture and an elegant movement of the ballerina’s hands emphasize the beauty of the dance, a stand in the form of a stylized flower complements the composition. Made in a realistic style, with a large number of fine details, the sculpture shows the workmanship and can decorate any interior. 

  - Black Swan (blackswan.obj, blackswanstand.obj)Black Swan, she is Odile - the heroine of the ballet of P. I. Tchaikovsky “Swan Lake”. To prevent the removal of witchcraft from Odette, the daughter of the evil wizard Rothbard in the guise of a black swan seduces Prince Siegfried, pretending to be Odette, and receives a declaration of love from him.

description_text:
What will I get?
You will get whatever you see in the screenshots.The project in .blend.Likeness sculpts of 6 Celebrities in .FBX form.from left to right is Angela Sarafyan, James Marsden, Lauren Cohan, Alexa Mansour, Jimmi Simpson, Summer Glau. FACS Reference - 34 expressions ( Shapekeys/Blendshapes )FACS based on Norman Reedus Likenessa basic basemesh based on BJ Novak Likeness.Included Teeth, Caruncle, and Eyeballs.Portfolio folder where I showcase my work.Features
4 Female, 2 Male, 1 Neutral Basemesh, 1 FACS All Quad!Subdivision ready!Sculpt ready using Multires!UV Unwrapped!Video Game Ready!Over 30+ different FACS to reference from!!
*what is FACS you ask? FACS stands for Facial Action Coding System or a list of Facial Movements that you can use it to blend between to get the expressions you want. *
Why should I buy it?
you can use the model as a base mesh for sculptingor use it as facial anatomy referenceFACS expressions for anatomy ReferenceGreat for Video game ProductionClean UV Layoutor just to simply help out a High School student like me make a few bucks : P*Instructions *
The .FBX basemeshes comes in High Poly onlyto get the lowest poly you need to use Multires Modifier and UNSUBDIVDIE it to the poly count of your choosingSome models are texture interchangeable, what does this mean? some model shares the same UV layout, which texture can be interchanged between 2 basemeshes for easier texture painting mostly.all basemeshes provided except 2 are using the same basemesh. which can be then combined into Morph target ( Shapekey /Blendshapes). I have no success in achieving such a result in Blender.FACS will be included in the BLENDER PROJECT as I have no success in exporting it out. Please Append it to a new .Blend rather than exporting it out as it will break the blend shapes.Background
Just a little background, I started learning 3D sculpting just a year ago, roughly around the same time I first heard of Blender. I first started doing stylized and cartoony head sculpt but later shifted into Realism and more realistic sculpt. and those heads that you see are the heads I have sculpted in recently. During my journey, I found that it's really hard to visualize Facial Anatomy 3 dimensionally without a reference or guide, not only that but using basemesh as a starting point is much more time-efficient while of course learning the fundamental of a person likeness. figured I might as well share these base meshes for anatomy reference at a reasonable price. and please if you in any way can't afford this just send me an email with your name and I will email a copy for free to you. 
Contact Information
if you have any suggestions, questions, comments, or just about anything, or heck if you want to hire me, please contact me at Tranbaochuong2003@yahoo.com. I also do Freelance work. 
Artstation page - https://artisawesome.artstation.com/

description_text:
A hole punch, also known as hole puncher, or paper puncher, is an office tool that is used to create holes in sheets of paper, often for the purpose of collecting the sheets in a binder or folder. The term can also refer to tools of different construction from one designed for paper, such as a those used for leather goods (generally called a leather punch), for cloth, for thin plastic sheeting, and for variations of sheet metal, such as aluminum siding or metal air ducts. 
There are multiple files attached for every use. Polygon file is also attached
Model: Esselte D25

description_text:
Elizabeth II (Elizabeth Alexandra Mary, born 21 April 1926)[a] is Queen of the United Kingdom and 15 other Commonwealth realms.[b] Elizabeth was born in Mayfair, London, as the first child of the Duke and Duchess of York (later King George VI and Queen Elizabeth). Her father ascended the throne on the abdication of his brother King Edward VIII in 1936, from which time she was the heir presumptive. She was educated privately at home and began to undertake public duties during the Second World War, serving in the Auxiliary Territorial Service. In 1947 she married Philip, Duke of Edinburgh, a former prince of Greece and Denmark, with whom she has four children: Charles, Prince of Wales; Anne, Princess Royal; Prince Andrew, Duke of York; and Prince Edward, Earl of Wessex.

description_text:
Need a strong hero or villain character for your game? 
Mafia Men - Yakuza Boss is the first installment of our Underworld Characters serials. 
There are two versions of the character 1) Character without jacket (10K tris) has 1 PBR material with 2 texture sets (4K) metal roughness and unity standard metallic. 2) Character with jacket (14K tris) has 2 PBR materials with 2 texture sets (4K) metal roughness and unity standard metallic. 
Texture set metal roughness contains maps BaseColor, Normal, Metallic, Roughness. Texture set unity standard metallic contains maps AlbedoTransparency, Normal, MetallicSmoothness. 
Both versions of the character are rigged with Mixamo which means you can apply any humanoid animation packs from the asset store to this character. This pack itself contains no animation. Props shown in the promo pictures like sunglasses (500 tris) and the show floor (25K tris) are included. 
Note: to re-create the same visual appearance shown in the promo video, one needs to set the project to use linear color space and Unity post processing stack (ver. above 2.0) and metal roughness texture set. 
Reviews with feedback are highly appreciate.

  - Assault rifle with 2 textures sets 

  - Plasma grenade with 2 textures sets 

  - A fully playable demo level 

The droid mesh consists of 10K tris and uses a single PBR material. The mesh is rigged and works well with Mecanim humanoid. Come with the model there are several animations to get you started: Idle, Holding Weapon, Shooting, Walk, Strafe, Death. 
With this package comes a fully playable third-person shooter level: The player controls a droid solider with the AI allies to battle the droids from the enemy faction to gain the control of an ancient temple. 
Everything appears in the demo level video is included which means the scripts, props, sound effects and visual effects are all there. This demo level serves as a playground for testing the model and can also be used as a starting point for your own levels. 
Note: to re-create the same visual appearance shown in the promo video, one needs to set the project to use linear color space, deferred render path, and Unity post processing stack. 
Reviews with feedback are highly appreciate.

description_text:
Morty is a low polygon model create for use in 3d animation. The mesh has been optimized to make it easier to rig and texture. The UVs have been flattened and unwrapped to make it easy to texture. The default scale is quite small, so it may need scaling, depending on the software ans settings. Morty is based on a character from one of my favorite animated series. Morty may also be used for 3d printing, with a little more work and a good pose. The model was originally created and recreated to improve design and to add a bit more personality to the sculpt. The polycount is approximately 8635, so not as low as it could be, but just high enough to support certain details. 
An updated Blender version of the model, with a simple armature has been added. The mesh has been revised into mirrored halves, making it easier to revise and update the model and assigned weights. The rig includes better skin weights, including a simple IK/stetchy leg setup.

description_text:
Introducing a new game ready asset: Modern Realistic Character - Female Agent.
Data about the model
(1) Character body and cloth is made of a single mesh (8575verts) which uses a single PBR material.Each material consists of a 2K Albedo, a 2k MetallicSmoothness, a 2k Normal maps.The material has three textures sets for three different looks (see promo picture).
(2) HandGun (2k verts) has one PBR material which consists of a 2K Albedo, a 2k MetallicSmoothness, a 2k Normal maps.
(3) GunCase (2k verts) has one PBR material which consists of a 512 Albedo, a 512 MetallicSmoothness, a 512 Normal maps.
(4) NameTag (269 verts) has one PBR material which consists of a 128 Albedo, a 128 Normal maps.
(5) Glasses (1088 verts) use an alpha map and you can change the color of the lenses.
(6) Hair (6360 verts) use an alpha map and you can change different hair colors.
(7) Character is rigged as biped humanoid with Mixamo. The model is in T-pose.
Note: There are two versions of files you can download one unity package and one source files with FBX. 
Note: This pack only contains agent character with her accessories and hand gun, no animations is included.
Note: to re-create the same visual appearance shown in the promo video, one needs to set the project to use linear color space and Unity post processing stack (ver. above 2.0).
Note: This asset is designed to be used in Unity in mind, you can of course use the source files in other engines.
Reviews with feedback are highly appreciated.

description_text:
Roadhog game character mask from Overwatch online FPS game from Blizzard.Contains 7 easily printable .stl files, all aligned to the printing platform.
SCALE SETTINGS AND OPTIONS:
The default size is set to the dimensions as mentioned in the infographic picture (width 196 mm without gas respirators, height 250 mm without gas respirators) with a thickness of mask around 5,5 mm.  It should be sufficient for the average head size and there is also some tolerance to attach cushions from the inner side for comfortable wearing. For smaller heads, we recommend to downscale the mask to around 80-90%. 
PRINTER SETTINGS:
All parts are aligned to heatbed and easily printable. Supports are required. Recommended layer height is 0.2-0.3 mm on FDM printers.
ASSEMBLY:
Check the infographic picture for assembly process.
Do you like the model and don't have a 3D printer? There are lots of people who offer 3D printing services these days. Try searching for someone who offers them in your area.
This fan-made model was brought to life by 3Demon. We are a group of modeling and 3d printing enthusiasts based in Prague, Czech Republic.

The model, rigging is done in 3D max 2010. The model is exported to other formats just as geometry, such as .3DS, .FBX, .OBJ

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EStjzREpotw

Completely polygonal model with low poly mesh that is smoothed with level of smoothness. 
Use number 1 level for working and fast behavior of the rig and use number 2 or 3 for rendering perfect smooth mesh like in the previews.

This character is rigged using a biped that way you can get some amazing controls and poses. Face rig with morpher modifier with 37 objectives. Check preview images for some interesting poses. Possibilities are endless.

Extra!!

Includes character animation cutting down a cylinder, lasts 200 fps and work on as a loop.

Scale armour is an early form of armour consisting of many individual small armour scales (plates) of various shapes attached to each other and to a backing of cloth or leather in overlapping rows.[1] Scale armour was worn by warriors of many different cultures as well as their horses. The material used to make the scales varied and included bronze, iron, rawhide, leather, cuir bouilli, seeds, horn, pangolin scales and, in ancient China, paper. The variations are primarily the result of material availability.Scale armour is armour in which the individual scales are sewn or laced to a backing by one or more edges and arranged in overlapping rows resembling the scales of a fish/reptile or roofing tiles.[2] Lorica squamata is an ancient Roman armour of this type[1] and gyorin kozane is the Japanese (samurai) name for this type of scale armour.[3]Other types of armours made from individual scales but constructed in a different manner have their own separate names such as lamellar armour where the individual scales are perforated on several or all edges and lashed tightly to each other in straight ridged rows and do not need to be attached to a backing. The Romans also had a variant called lorica plumata in which the scales were attached to mail.[4]

description_text:
Elegant pair of Black Cat Earrings, including a left and right object selection.  The pair together contains a combined total of 7,228 polygons, and 7,284 vertices (3,614 quads per earring). The models have been carefully UV Unwrapped, without overlapping edges, to prevent texture distortion.  There are no texture maps provided with this set, but each earring has 8 distinct material zones, and can easily accept any seamless, metallic procedural material, in any software render engine.
The .MAX file format contains both models, created to scale using Centimeters as the scene units of measure.  The modifier stack has been collapsed for compatibility.  No plugins or addons are required.
The (POSER).obj files have been scaled to import perfectly to the fit the "Genesis 2 Base Female" character in Daz|Studio 4.x., and should import in an approximate location in Poser.  See the included README.TXT for detailed information about how to import these objects to your scene.

description_text:
The Realistic Eyeball Generator is a procedural tool created in Substance Designer. It presents a great opportunity in a short time to generate a variety of options for characters’ eyes.
You can change multiple parameters for Pupil, Iris, Veins, Sclera without additional efforts, just using the Realistic Eyeball Generator.
The file contains:

  - 2 different types of mesh (cornea + sclera for realtime or for offline render); 

  - 9 Vray-materials with customized textures;

  - HDRI for render;

  - eyeball.sbsar;

  - 8 presets (Blue, Brown, Grey, Green, Snake, Vampire, Demon, Ice).

It’s recommended to use Snake/Vampire/Demon/Ice presets with mesh for realtime render.
File formats:

  - .max

  - .obj

  - .fbx

  - .sbsar

  - .sppr

Polygons and Vertices: Polys - 962 Verts - 948 Tris - 1888
Some types of textures:

  - for V-Ray: Diffuse, Glossiness, Normal, Height, Reflection, IOR, Opacity

  - for Unity and Unreal Engine

Textures Resolutions (in PNG format) - 2048 x 2048 
The preview images are rendered with the V-Ray 3.60.03 renderer and Marmoset Tool 3. Gamma 2.2.
If you render this file using a different version of this renderer, you may not have the same results as you see on the thumbnails.
Please contact me if you have any issues with the model.
Thank you for your purchase, I hope this model will be useful for your project!
And don't forget to rate the model, I really appreciate it!
Best regards, Ilona

To the ancients, this shape was thought to signify everything from Spirit, Mind, and Body; to Mother, Father, Child. I chose to eliminate the circle enclosure here to draw more attention to the Triad's own aesthetic symmetry.

Multifunctional equipment, composed of 01 (one) platform at 1.20m high from which several recreational components of ascents and descents come out.The goal is to provide motor, psychological and social development by promoting climb, slip, run and socialize.To this end, the recreational accessories of the equipment 01 (one) slide, 01 (one) inclined ladder, 01 (one) vertical ladder of trunks and 01 (one) fireman's tube are part of the recreational equipment.As safety features, guardrails are installed with uprights vertically arranged, which prevent the child from climbing this accessory. In addition, safety straps on all gaps and plastic caps that overlap all connections and screws.This equipment is designed to meet the requirements of the NBR 16071 Safety Standards for Playground.
Material usedIn Version 4.0:

  - Columns: Trunks of Eucalyptus autoclaved with 13cm in diameter.

  - Platforms: Beam in profile 4.5 x 10 cm and floor deque in profile 2.0 x 10 cm of tropical high density solid wood (Itauba, Cumaru, or equivalent).

  - Inclined Stairs: Steps in steel tubes with 25mm of diameter fixed to trunks of Eclalipto Autoclavado with 13cm of diameter

  - Slipper: High Density Polyethylene (HDPE) plastic pre-consumer recycled.

  - Security Grids: Steel tubes with 25mm diameter crosspieces and 12mm diameter posts.

description_text:
Diamond[a] is one of the best-known and most sought-after gemstones. They have been used as decorative items since ancient times.
The hardness of diamond and its high dispersion of light—giving the diamond its characteristic fire—make it useful for industrial applications and desirable as jewellery. Diamonds are such a highly traded commodity that multiple organizations have been created for grading and certifying them based on the four Cs, which are color, cut, clarity, and carat. Other characteristics, such as presence or lack of fluorescence, also affect the desirability and thus the value of a diamond used for jewelry.
Diamonds are used in engagement rings. The practice is documented among European aristocracy as early as the 15th century, though ruby and sapphire were more desirable gemstones. The modern popularity of diamonds was largely created by De Beers Consolidated Mines, which established the first large-scale diamonds mines in South Africa. Through an advertising campaign beginning in the 1930s and continuing into the mid-20th century, De Beers made diamonds into a key part of the betrothal process and a coveted symbol of status. The diamond's high value has been the driving force behind dictators and revolutionary entities, especially in Africa, using slave and child labor to mine blood diamonds to fund conflicts. Though popularly believed to derive its value from its rarity, gem-quality diamonds are quite common compared to rare gemstones such as alexandrite, and annual global rough diamond production is estimated to be about 130 million carats (26 tonnes; 29 short tons).[1
